# The Undertow

*A deeply touched deep-sea fish longer than any ship that comes through the gap, lying in the Scour under the Forest Jaw. It rises where the water moves first. Potions work in the Scour; scrolls do not.*

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Boss | [The Undertow](../monsters/undertow.md) |
| Arena | [The Scour](../maps/the_scour.md) |

- Unlocked by [Under the Jaw](../quests/iska_under_the_jaw.md)
- Entered by talking to [Iska](../npcs/first_warden_iska.md)
